zh: 吃完晚饭我们结清了账就回家了。
en: After dinner we {settled up|paid up|paid} and went home.

zh: 我们大概每周在外面吃一次。
en: We {eat out|dine out|go out} about once a week.

zh: 是在这儿吃还是带走？
en: Is that to have here or {take away|takeaway|take out|to take away|to go}?

zh: 咖啡馆十点前就把燕麦奶用完了。
en: The café {ran out of|was out of|sold out of} oat milk by ten o'clock.

zh: 我回家路上顺便去取披萨。
en: I'll {pick up|grab|collect|get} the pizza on my way home.

zh: 我们在那家泰国餐馆订了七点的位子。
en: We're {booked in|booked} for seven at the Thai place.

zh: 订了位，结果有一半的人没来。
en: Half the group didn't {turn up|show up|come|show|arrive} for the booking.

zh: 这顿饭每个人凑了二十块钱。
en: Everyone {chipped in|put in|paid|gave|contributed} twenty dollars for the meal.

zh: 主菜上来之前别吃面包吃饱了。
en: Don't {fill up on} bread before the mains arrive.

zh: 你能帮我把这个派热一下吗？
en: Could you {heat up|warm up|heat|warm|reheat|microwave} this pie for me?

zh: 服务员一直在给我们的水杯加水。
en: The waiter keeps {topping up|filling up|refilling|filling} our water glasses.

zh: 孩子们两分钟就把整份甜点吃了个精光。
en: The kids {polished off|finished off|finished|ate|demolished|wolfed down} the whole dessert in two minutes.

zh: 菜要凉了，大家快开吃吧！
en: The food's getting cold, so {tuck in|dig in|eat up|start|eat}, everyone!

zh: 今晚叫外卖吧，我不想做饭。
en: Let's {order in|get takeaways|get takeaway|order takeaways|order takeaway} tonight. I don't feel like cooking.

zh: 我想我就点羊肉吧。
en: I think I'll {go for|have|get|order|try|choose|take} the lamb.

zh: 这个汉堡配薯条吗？
en: Does the burger {come with|include|have} chips?

zh: 我们在靠窗的一张桌子旁坐了下来。
en: We {sat down|sat} at a table by the window.

zh: 我们还没吃完，服务员就把盘子收走了。
en: The waiter {cleared away|took away|cleared|removed|took|collected} our plates before we'd finished.

zh: 上班前我们顺路进去喝了杯咖啡。
en: We {popped in|stopped in|dropped in|called in|stopped|stopped off} for a quick coffee before work.

zh: 九点钟那家早午餐店外面就有人在排队了。
en: People were {queuing up|queueing up|lining up|queuing|queueing|waiting} outside the brunch place by nine.

zh: 注意听他们叫你的名字，咖啡好了会叫的。
en: {Listen out for|Listen for} your name when your coffee's ready.

zh: 他一个人吃掉了一整个披萨。
en: He {put away|polished off|wolfed down|scoffed|demolished|ate} a whole pizza by himself.

zh: 谁想把剩下的披萨吃完？
en: Who wants to {finish off|finish|polish off|eat up} the pizza?

zh: 把烧烤炉点起来吧，客人快到了。
en: {Fire up|Light|Start|Heat up} the barbie, the guests are almost here.

zh: 昨晚我们狂吃了一顿披萨。
en: We totally {pigged out|stuffed ourselves|gorged ourselves} on pizza last night.

zh: 我上大学时几乎天天吃方便面。
en: At uni I basically {lived off|lived on|survived on} instant noodles.

zh: 米饭粘在锅底了。
en: The rice {stuck to} the bottom of the pot.

zh: 在这儿吃还是带走？
en: Is that to {eat in|have here} or take away?

zh: 她没什么胃口，只是拨弄着盘子里的食物。
en: She wasn't hungry and just {picked at|played with|pushed around} her food.

zh: 牛奶溢出来之前把火关小。
en: Turn down the heat before the milk {boils over}.

zh: 城里好像每周都会冒出新的咖啡馆。
en: New cafés seem to {spring up|pop up|open up|appear} all over town every week.

zh: 游了一上午泳，我胃口大开。
en: I've {worked up|built up} an appetite after swimming all morning.

zh: 加点辣椒让这道菜更有滋味。
en: Add some chilli to {spice up|liven up|jazz up|pep up} the dish.

zh: 我摆桌子，你能把饭菜盛出来吗？
en: Can you {dish up|serve|serve up} while I set the table?

zh: 咖啡钱我已经付过了。
en: I've already {paid for} the coffees.

zh: 这杯饮料尝起来像兑了水。
en: This drink tastes {watered down}.

zh: 最后我们吃了个奶油蛋白饼，给这顿饭画上完美的句号。
en: We {rounded off|finished off|topped off|capped off|finished|ended} the meal with a pavlova.

zh: 孩子们狼吞虎咽地吃起了炸鱼薯条。
en: The kids {tucked into|dug into|got stuck into} their fish and chips.

zh: 他就着一杯冰啤酒把派吃了下去。
en: He {washed down} the pie with a cold beer.

zh: 餐厅满了，我们被拒之门外。
en: We got {turned away} because the restaurant was full.

zh: 谢谢，今晚甜点我就不要了。
en: Thanks, but I'll {pass on|skip} dessert tonight.

zh: 把面团擀开，擀得薄一点。
en: {Roll out} the dough until it's nice and thin.

zh: 快把酒喝完，酒吧要关门了。
en: {Drink up}, the bar's about to close.

zh: 三分钟后把牛排翻个面。
en: {Turn over|Flip|Flip over} the steak after three minutes.

zh: 最近这一带开了很多新咖啡馆。
en: New cafés are {popping up|springing up|opening up|opening} all over this area.

zh: 我随手做了个简单的沙拉。
en: I {threw together|whipped up|made} a quick salad.

zh: 犹豫了半天，我最后选了炸鱼薯条。
en: After a lot of thought, I {plumped for|went for|chose|picked|settled on|opted for} the fish and chips.

zh: 让汤凉一会儿再喝。
en: Let the soup {cool down|cool} a bit before you eat it.

zh: 放入洋葱，翻炒一下。
en: {Throw in|Chuck in|Add|Put in} the onions and stir.

zh: 他一个人把整个披萨吃光了。
en: He {polished off|finished off|scoffed|wolfed down|demolished|finished} the whole pizza on his own.

zh: 蛋糕够每人一块吗？
en: Is there enough cake to {go round|go around}?

zh: 做饭前先把头发往后扎起来。
en: {Pull back|Tie back|Tie up} your hair before you start cooking.

zh: 牛排中间还是生的，所以我把它退回了厨房。
en: The steak was raw in the middle, so I {sent back|returned|took back} the plate.

zh: 把洋葱和大蒜切碎。
en: {Chop up|Chop|Dice|Cut up} the onions and garlic.

zh: 排长队把很多顾客都吓跑了。
en: The long queue {put off|scared off|deterred|turned away} a lot of customers.

zh: 牛奶已经坏了。
en: The milk has {gone off|gone sour|turned}.

zh: 他五分钟就狼吞虎咽地吃完了午饭。
en: He {wolfed down|gobbled down|gobbled|scoffed} his lunch in five minutes.
